doc: Logo sources for asset-forge (data, not code). source=commons: downloaded from the url and kept as SVG; source=remade: a wordmark set in an OFL face from assets/fonts and outlined to SVG. Trademarks belong to their owners and are used only to identify the car. mono: auto | silhouette | knockout.

logos.name: Acura
logos.notes: Official Acura caliper emblem over wordmark; crop the emblem for small sizes.

logos.name: Alfa Romeo
logos.licence: MIT (asset-forge wordmark; name is a trademark of its owner)
logos.notes: No Alfa Romeo brand logo SVG on Commons: the scudetto/biscione badge is only a non-free PNG on en.wiki (File:Alfa Romeo logo.png); Commons has model wordmarks only (Giulia, Stelvio, 4C...). Remake needed.

logos.name: Alpine
logos.notes: Commons has no Alpine car-brand SVG (en.wiki uses a JPG). The Alpine F1 Team logo carries the same official "A" arrow mark above "ALPINE F1 TEAM" text: crop to the A-arrow (optionally keep the ALPINE word), drop the F1 TEAM line. Other "Alpine logo" SVGs on Commons are Alpine Electronics / Alpine Bau, not the carmaker.
